blocks.caption: Figure 7.1 — Cosmopolis · Humanesque · From Matter to Intent: A Unified Thermodynamic, Geometric, and PoLPEST Architecture.
blocks.explanation: The master framework poster. It opens with the civilizational triad in equilibrium, then gives the civilizational engine as an eight-stage loop that never terminates: intent, refinement, realization, verification, learning, adaptation, repair, evolution — a regenerative cybernetic cycle that self-updates rather than running to completion, keeping realization aligned with intent over the long run. The third section defines Zistgah as the habitat container that holds matter, energy and intent in continuous equilibrium, and traces the continuum from Earth as the proving ground through Mars as the resilience laboratory and the Moon as the efficiency laboratory to open-ended expansion beyond. The fourth section is the economy of agency: as one moves along the chain from matter to energy to information to knowledge to semantics to intent, capital intensity falls and individual leverage rises — the ground for the three equities of culture, language and individual participation.
blocks.tts: Cosmopolis, Humanesque, and from matter to intent. Intent is permanent, realization is temporary, verification is mandatory, and continuity is the measure of civilization.
